8.1.en: Arjuna drops a list of deep questions: What's the ultimate reality? What's the self? What's karma?
8.1.hi: Arjun gehre sawaalon ki list deta hai: Ultimate reality kya hai? Self kya hai? Karma kya hai?

8.2.en: "And how can someone remember you at the moment of death?" The biggest question of all.
8.2.hi: "Aur maut ke waqt koi aapko kaise yaad rakh sakta hai?" Sabse bada sawaal.

8.3.en: Krishna: "The ultimate reality never changes. Your true nature is your self. Karma is the action that creates life."
8.3.hi: Krishna: "Ultimate reality kabhi nahi badalti. Tumhari asli nature tumhara self hai. Karma woh action hai jo life banata hai."

8.4.en: "The physical world keeps changing. The cosmic spirit runs it. And I live inside every body."
8.4.hi: "Physical duniya badalti rehti hai. Cosmic spirit use chalata hai. Aur main har body ke andar hoon."

8.5.en: Whoever thinks of me at their last moment comes straight to me. No doubt about it.
8.5.hi: Jo aakhri pal mein mujhe yaad karta hai, woh seedha mere paas aata hai. Isme koi shak nahi.

8.6.en: Whatever you think about most in life is what you'll think of at the end. And that's where you'll go.
8.6.hi: Life mein jo sabse zyada sochte ho, wahi aakhir mein yaad aata hai. Aur wahin pahunchte ho.

8.7.en: So remember me all the time, and keep doing your work. Mind and heart on me, you'll reach me.
8.7.hi: Toh mujhe hamesha yaad rakho, aur apna kaam karte raho. Mind aur dil mujh pe, toh mujh tak pahunchoge.

8.8.en: Practise focusing, don't let your mind drift, and you'll reach the supreme.
8.8.hi: Focus ki practice karo, mind ko bhatakne mat do, aur tum param tak pahunchoge.

8.9.en: Meditate on the one who knows all, is ancient, subtle, shines like the sun and is beyond darkness.
8.9.hi: Us par dhyaan karo jo sab jaanta hai, sabse purana hai, sookshm hai, suraj jaisa chamakta hai aur andhere se pare hai.

8.10.en: At the end, with a steady mind full of love and focus, you reach that supreme being.
8.10.hi: Aakhir mein steady mind, pyaar aur focus ke saath, tum us param tak pahunchte ho.

8.11.en: Here's a quick summary of the ultimate goal that wise people work so hard to reach.
8.11.hi: Ab us ultimate goal ka short summary, jiske liye gyaani itni mehnat karte hain.

8.12.en: Close off distractions, centre your mind in your heart, and stay steady in meditation.
8.12.hi: Distractions band karo, mind ko dil mein tikao, aur dhyaan mein steady raho.

8.13.en: Chant Om and think of me as you leave your body, and you reach the highest goal.
8.13.hi: Body chhodte waqt Om japo aur mujhe yaad karo, toh sabse ooncha goal milta hai.

8.14.en: For someone who remembers me constantly with full focus, I'm easy to reach.
8.14.hi: Jo mujhe lagataar poore focus se yaad karta hai, uske liye main aasaani se milta hoon.

8.15.en: Those who reach me don't come back to a temporary world full of pain. They've made it.
8.15.hi: Jo mujh tak pahunchte hain, woh dukh bhari temporary duniya mein wapas nahi aate. Woh pahunch gaye.

8.16.en: Every world, even the highest heaven, has a return ticket. Reach me and there's no return.
8.16.hi: Har lok, sabse ooncha swarg bhi, wapsi ka ticket hai. Mujh tak pahuncho toh wapsi nahi.

8.17.en: A single day of the creator lasts thousands of ages. Our timeline is tiny on the cosmic scale.
8.17.hi: Brahma ka ek din hazaaron yugon ka hota hai. Cosmic scale pe hamari timeline bahut chhoti hai.

8.18.en: When the cosmic day starts, everything appears. When cosmic night falls, everything dissolves.
8.18.hi: Jab cosmic din shuru hota hai, sab prakat hota hai. Jab cosmic raat aati hai, sab vileen ho jaata hai.

8.19.en: Beings appear and disappear again and again, on repeat, with every cosmic day and night.
8.19.hi: Jeev baar-baar aate aur jaate hain, repeat pe, har cosmic din aur raat ke saath.

8.20.en: But beyond all that is something eternal that never gets destroyed, even when everything else does.
8.20.hi: Par in sabke pare kuch hamesha rehne wala hai jo kabhi khatam nahi hota, jab sab kuch khatam ho jaaye tab bhi.

8.21.en: That eternal state is my home. Once you reach it, you never come back.
8.21.hi: Woh hamesha wali state mera ghar hai. Ek baar pahuncho, toh wapas nahi aate.

8.22.en: The supreme, who holds everything, is reached through pure, single-minded devotion.
8.22.hi: Jo param sab ko sambhale hai, woh sirf shuddh, ek-man bhakti se milta hai.

8.23.en: Now I'll tell you about the two ways people leave this world: one with return, one without.
8.23.hi: Ab main batata hoon duniya chhodne ke do raaste: ek wapsi wala, ek bina wapsi.

8.24.en: The path of light: those who know the truth take this route and don't come back.
8.24.hi: Roshni ka raasta: jo sach jaante hain woh is raaste se jaate hain aur wapas nahi aate.

8.25.en: The path of smoke and darkness: those who take this route come back again.
8.25.hi: Dhuein aur andhere ka raasta: jo is raaste se jaate hain, woh phir lautte hain.

8.26.en: Two eternal paths, light and dark. One leads out of the cycle, the other back into it.
8.26.hi: Do hamesha wale raaste, roshni aur andhera. Ek cycle se bahar le jaata hai, dusra wapas.

8.27.en: A yogi who knows these paths isn't confused. So stay steady in yoga, always.
8.27.hi: Jo yogi ye raaste jaanta hai, woh confuse nahi hota. Toh hamesha yoga mein steady raho.

8.28.en: Know this, and you go beyond all the rewards of rituals and good deeds to the supreme state.
8.28.hi: Ye jaan lo, toh rituals aur punya ke saare rewards se aage param state tak pahunchte ho.
